description: Capella's cloud/eventing/eventing-advanced-keyspace-accessors.md carries four 'Couchbase Server 7.6/7.6.2' version-since badges (touch, mutateIn, lookupIn, self_recursion) with zero matching mentions anywhere on the Server 8.0 twin. Round 18 found three more instances of the identical pattern on other pages in this batch (eventing-language-constructs.md, eventing-Terminologies.md, eventing-curl-spec.md), all missing the equivalent badge on the Server 8.0 page for content that is otherwise byte-identical. Suggests a version-since templating macro that renders on the Capella build but not on the current Server build, rather than four independent authoring omissions.
